overrides: PageSpecs carry styling only through node.style props listed in styleProps (schema-closed per section). There is no per-instance colour, spacing or font override field; any style value must be a catalog token path of an allowed category and one of the values observed in the clone for that section (theme/token combination).

rawValueRestrictions.blur: only blur tokens from the catalog
rawValueRestrictions.breakpoint: only breakpoint tokens from the catalog
rawValueRestrictions.color: raw hex/rgb/hsl/oklab forbidden; use color.* or semantic text.*/surface.*/border.* tokens
rawValueRestrictions.container: only container tokens from the catalog
rawValueRestrictions.duration: only duration tokens from the catalog
rawValueRestrictions.easing: only easing tokens from the catalog
rawValueRestrictions.elevation: only elevation tokens from the catalog
rawValueRestrictions.fontFamily: only font.family.display|sans|mono (Outfit / IBM Plex Mono stacks)
rawValueRestrictions.fontWeight: only fontWeight tokens from the catalog
rawValueRestrictions.iconSize: only iconSize tokens from the catalog
rawValueRestrictions.letterSpacing: only letterSpacing tokens from the catalog
rawValueRestrictions.spacing: raw px/rem/em forbidden; use space.* tokens
rawValueRestrictions.zIndex: only zIndex tokens from the catalog
